title: Marvel Comics Presents #1 2 7 Lot 2019 Arthur Adams Wolverine Iron Man
condition_description: All three covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Marvel Comics Presents (2019 series), Marvel Comics - #1, #2 and #7, all with Arthur Adams covers. $4.99 cover price each.

You get:
- #1 - first issue, Marvel 80 Years. Wolverine ("Wolverine Begins His Vigil" by Charles Soule and Paulo Siqueira), Captain America and Namor. Back cover: Marvel Contest of Champions ad.
- #2 - Wolverine, Mister Fantastic ("Mister Fantastic Joins the Space Race!") and Gorilla-Man. Back cover: Citizen Captain Marvel watch ad.
- #7 - Wolverine, Iron Man ("Iron Man vs. the Great Recession!" by Ryan North and Rod Reis) and the Winter Soldier. Back cover: AXE The Freshmen ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
